entities.name: Demons
entities.description: Powerful, evil beings, usually pure manifestations of black mana, who exact a price from those who deal with them.

entities.name: Lord of the Pit
entities.description: A powerful winged demon with a jaw of razor teeth, commonly summoned on Dominaria and requiring constant sacrifices.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: A mage who summoned a Lord of the Pit at the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.

entities.name: Thomil
entities.description: A mage who lost control of a Lord of the Pit he summoned against Worzel.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: A Shard of Alara where demons run rampant, consuming the living.

entities.name: Razaketh
entities.description: A demon who guarded the Gate to the Afterlife on Amonkhet until the Hour of Devastation.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The Elder Dragon whom the demons of Ifnir resemble, said to have banished them.

entities.name: Daemogoths
entities.description: The demons of Arcavios, who feed on misery and offer deals trading pain for forbidden knowledge.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: A powerful demon imprisoned in a house on Duskmourn who expanded it to occupy the plane in the Ascension and killed most other demons.

entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: The demon who held the highest rank among Innistrad's demons before his destruction.

entities.name: Ormendahl
entities.description: The demon who succeeded Griselbrand as the highest ranked of Innistrad's demons.

entities.name: Skirsdag
entities.description: A secret demon cult centered in the High City of Thraben.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel whose arrival on Innistrad created a new equilibrium and opened a space for demons.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose arrival transformed the Ashmouth and corrupted many demons.

entities.name: Ashmouth
entities.description: The largest gateway to the demons' native realm, in Stensia's Geier Reach, altered by Emrakul.

entities.name: Aclazotz
aliases: the bat god of the night
entities.description: The bat god of night on Ixalan, said to be the origin of the plane's demons.

entities.name: Chimil
entities.description: The sun of Ixalan's core which Aclazotz tried to eclipse.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: The gods who sealed the demons into Immersturm; defeated by the Skoti.

entities.name: Skoti
entities.description: The gods who defeated the Einir and resealed Immersturm with runic magic.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: The realm on Kaldheim where demons are sealed by runes.

entities.name: Oni
entities.description: Malevolent kami of evil and chaos on Kamigawa, locked away by Kyodai and released during the Kami War.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: The kami who locked the oni in the spirit realm centuries ago.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: A planeswalker whose bat-like demonic minions fought in the battle of Kjeldor and Balduvia.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A planeswalker whose demonic minions aided Lim-Dul and who died in the attack of the Nine Titans.

entities.name: Lim-Dul
entities.description: A necromancer aided by the minions of Leshrac and Tevesh Szat.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian referred to as a demon in the story though typed as a Praetor on his card.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian god whose Inner Circle was mostly composed of demons.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: The most famous demon of Ravnica, parun and guildmaster of the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: A Sultai khan who offended the rakshasa and made a pact with Silumgar.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: A dragonlord who took over the rakshasa's pacts with the Sultai.

entities.name: Rakshasa
entities.description: Shapeshifting demons of Tarkir with whom the Sultai made pacts.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: The most notable demon on Zendikar, a fallen planeswalker who lost his spark and sought revenge on the land.

entities.name: Xathrid
entities.description: A powerful demonic force on Shandalar who commands demons and is worshipped by a cult.

entities.name: Capenna
entities.description: A plane where archdemons cooperated with angels against a Phyrexian incursion and later betrayed them.

events.summary: The demons of Capenna cooperate with angels to stave off a Phyrexian incursion, then betray and imprison the angels in stone.
events.quote: the demons soon betrayed the battle-weary angels and imprisoned them in stone, leeching off halo from them

events.summary: Valgavoth expands his house over Duskmourn in the Ascension and kills most of the plane's other demons.
events.quote: One of his first acts after subsuming control of the plane was killing most of the plane's other demons and breaking the rest

events.summary: Avacyn and her angels restore balance on Innistrad, opening an opportunity for demons to manifest.
events.quote: The demons and their hosts of devils began to arrive, one by one.

events.summary: Emrakul's arrival transforms the Ashmouth, spawning warped Ashspawn demons.
events.quote: Warped and twisted demons emerged from the chasm.

events.summary: Aclazotz turns several Legion of Dusk vampires into demons to help eclipse Chimil.
events.quote: several Legion of Dusk vampires were turned into demons by Aclazotz

events.summary: The Skoti defeat the Einir and the relics sealing the demons are lost.
events.quote: When the Skoti challenged the Einir's supremacy and defeated them, these relics were lost.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Kyodai is distracted and oni begin escaping into the mortal realm.
events.quote: oni began escaping into the mortal realm

events.summary: Tasigur offends the rakshasa and makes a pact with Silumgar, who inherits their pacts.
events.quote: Tasigur made a pact with Silumgar

relations.note: Held the highest rank among Innistrad's demons before his destruction.
relations.quote: the demon Griselbrand held previously the highest rank before his destruction

relations.note: Claims authority over the demons of Ravnica.
relations.quote: Rakdos claims authority over all the demons of this world

relations.note: Rules Duskmourn and its remaining minor demons.
relations.quote: Some minor demons remain under Valgavoth's control
When the Skoti challenged the Einir's supremacy and defeated them

who used them to lend assistance to the necromancer Lim-Dûl

relations.note: Ixalan's demons are thought to be his spawn.
relations.quote: Demons on Ixalan are thought to be the spawn of Aclazotz
